snippet.title: making a POLISHED game in a month (art, programming, music, ...)
snippet.description:
ig the real fun is in challenging yourself in creating stuff you didn't know you could make.

if you would like to try out the game for yourself: https://evanciao.itch.io/time

this video was rushed since I was feeling real burnt out by this whole project, so apologies in advance.
I also messed up the project settings and the vid is at 30fps instead of 60fps smh.

software used: Unity, Blender, Krita, Audacity and FL Studio.

0:00 intro
0:34 disclaimer!
0:40 story-writing
1:50 3D modelling (character)
3:30 3D modelling (level)
5:00 programming stuff
9:45 animatingg
11:00 music
12:15 outro (yapping)

some music credits:
- by richmnkey - [free] breakcore X dnb type beat - "hellsing"
- by prod.gomaa - jungle dnb x ambient
- by bluuji - (free for profit) super sad breakcore type beat
